name: Fluency
description: The generated text should be grammatically correct, coherent, and fluent, without any spelling or punctuation errors.

name: Relevance
description: The generated text should be relevant to the context and topic of the conversation. It should also take into account the interesting fact provided.

name: Engagement
description: The generated text should be engaging and interesting to the reader. This can be determined by the use of varied vocabulary, creative language, and the introduction of new ideas or perspectives.

name: Coherence
description: The generated text should maintain a logical flow and coherence with the context and the previous dialogue. It should be able to continue the conversation in a natural and seamless way.

name: Creativity
description: The generated text should demonstrate creativity in its response. This can be in the form of introducing new ideas, perspectives, or humor.

name: Factual Accuracy
description: The generated text should be factually accurate, especially when referring to the interesting fact provided.
